answer: Operator-Linked Identity Quarantine. Each agent wallet declares an operator key at registration; actions from wallets sharing an operator are pooled. If any wallet in a pool is flagged for sybil behavior, the operator's whole pool is frozen, and every wallet must forge a fresh operator key and pay a copper-denominated re-entry fee per identity plus a waiting period. An attacker must fund a distinct key and fee for each identity, so N sybils cost N fees; the relic record of frozen pools blocks cheap re-registration by the same operator.
